SELECT p.proc_id, p.item_id, p.equip_id, p.proc_code, p.proc_name, p.proc_content, p.created_date, p.updated_date, p.remark,
i.item_code, i.item_name, i.item_type, i.item_unit,
CASE WHEN i.item_type = 'FG' THEN '완제품' WHEN i.item_type = 'RM' THEN '원자재' WHEN i.item_type = 'SM' THEN '부자재' ELSE i.item_type END AS item_type_name,
e.equip_code, e.equip_name, e.equip_status, e.equip_loc,
l.line_id, l.line_code, l.line_name, l.line_status,
e.equip_code || ' / ' || e.equip_name AS equip_display_name, l.line_code || ' / ' || l.line_name AS line_display_name
FROM process p
LEFT JOIN item i ON i.item_id = p.item_id
LEFT JOIN equipment e ON e.equip_id = p.equip_id
LEFT JOIN line l ON l.line_id = e.line_id
ORDER BY p.proc_id DESC

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM process p
LEFT JOIN item i ON i.item_id = p.item_id
LEFT JOIN equipment e ON e.equip_id = p.equip_id
LEFT JOIN line l ON l.line_id = e.line_id

SELECT p.proc_id, p.item_id, p.equip_id, p.proc_code, p.proc_name, p.proc_content, p.created_date, p.updated_date, p.remark,
i.item_code, i.item_name, i.item_type, i.item_unit,
CASE WHEN i.item_type = 'FG' THEN '완제품' WHEN i.item_type = 'RM' THEN '원자재' WHEN i.item_type = 'SM' THEN '부자재' ELSE i.item_type END AS item_type_name,
e.equip_code, e.equip_name, e.equip_status, e.equip_loc,
l.line_id, l.line_code, l.line_name, l.line_status,
e.equip_code || ' / ' || e.equip_name AS equip_display_name, l.line_code || ' / ' || l.line_name AS line_display_name
FROM process p
LEFT JOIN item i ON i.item_id = p.item_id
LEFT JOIN equipment e ON e.equip_id = p.equip_id
LEFT JOIN line l ON l.line_id = e.line_id
WHERE p.proc_id = #{procId}

SELECT NVL(MAX(proc_id), 0) + 1 FROM process
INSERT INTO process ( proc_id, item_id, equip_id, proc_code, proc_name, proc_content, created_date, updated_date, remark ) VALUES ( #{procId}, #{itemId}, #{equipId}, #{procCode}, #{procName}, #{procContent}, SYSDATE, SYSDATE, #{remark} )
mapper.update: UPDATE process SET item_id = #{itemId}, equip_id = #{equipId}, proc_code = #{procCode}, proc_name = #{procName}, proc_content = #{procContent}, updated_date = SYSDATE, remark = #{remark} WHERE proc_id = #{procId}

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM process
WHERE UPPER(proc_code) = UPPER(#{procCode})
AND proc_id != #{procId}

SELECT proc_code, proc_name FROM ( SELECT p.proc_code, MAX(p.proc_name) AS proc_name FROM process p WHERE p.proc_code IS NOT NULL AND ( UPPER(p.proc_code) LIKE '%' || UPPER(#{keyword}) || '%' OR UPPER(p.proc_name) LIKE '%' || UPPER(#{keyword}) || '%' ) GROUP BY p.proc_code ORDER BY CASE WHEN UPPER(p.proc_code) = UPPER(#{keyword}) THEN 1 WHEN UPPER(p.proc_code) LIKE UPPER(#{keyword}) || '%' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END, p.proc_code ) WHERE ROWNUM <= 10

SELECT pd.proc_id AS proc_detail_id, pd.proc_id2 AS proc_id, pd.proc_picture, pd.proc_content, pd.created_date, pd.updated_date, pd.remark,
p.proc_code, p.proc_name, p.item_id, p.equip_id,
i.item_code, i.item_name,
e.equip_code, e.equip_name,
l.line_id, l.line_code, l.line_name
FROM process_detail pd
LEFT JOIN process p ON p.proc_id = pd.proc_id2
LEFT JOIN item i ON i.item_id = p.item_id
LEFT JOIN equipment e ON e.equip_id = p.equip_id
LEFT JOIN line l ON l.line_id = e.line_id
WHERE pd.proc_id2 = #{procId}
ORDER BY pd.proc_id DESC

SELECT item_id, supplier_id, client_id, item_code, item_name, item_type, safety_stock, item_unit, remark, created_date, updated_date, use_yn,
CASE WHEN item_type = 'FG' THEN '완제품' WHEN item_type = 'RM' THEN '원자재' WHEN item_type = 'SM' THEN '부자재' ELSE item_type END AS item_type_name,
CASE WHEN use_yn = 'Y' THEN '사용' WHEN use_yn = 'N' THEN '미사용' ELSE use_yn END AS use_yn_name
FROM ( SELECT i.item_id, i.supplier_id, i.client_id, i.item_code, i.item_name, i.item_type, i.safety_stock, i.item_unit, i.remark, i.created_date, i.updated_date, i.use_yn FROM item i WHERE i.item_type = 'FG' AND NVL(i.use_yn, 'Y') = 'Y' AND ( UPPER(i.item_code) LIKE '%' || UPPER(#{keyword}) || '%' OR UPPER(i.item_name) LIKE '%' || UPPER(#{keyword}) || '%' ) ORDER BY CASE WHEN UPPER(i.item_code) = UPPER(#{keyword}) THEN 1 WHEN UPPER(i.item_name) = UPPER(#{keyword}) THEN 2 WHEN UPPER(i.item_code) LIKE UPPER(#{keyword}) || '%' THEN 3 WHEN UPPER(i.item_name) LIKE UPPER(#{keyword}) || '%' THEN 4 ELSE 5 END, i.item_code ) WHERE ROWNUM <= 10

SELECT i.item_id, i.supplier_id, i.client_id, i.item_code, i.item_name, i.item_type, i.safety_stock, i.item_unit, i.remark, i.created_date, i.updated_date, i.use_yn,
CASE WHEN i.item_type = 'FG' THEN '완제품' WHEN i.item_type = 'RM' THEN '원자재' WHEN i.item_type = 'SM' THEN '부자재' ELSE i.item_type END AS item_type_name,
CASE WHEN i.use_yn = 'Y' THEN '사용' WHEN i.use_yn = 'N' THEN '미사용' ELSE i.use_yn END AS use_yn_name
FROM item i
WHERE i.item_type = 'FG' AND NVL(i.use_yn, 'Y') = 'Y'
ORDER BY i.item_code

SELECT equip_id, equip_code, equip_name, equip_status, equip_loc, line_id, line_code, line_name, line_status, equip_display_name, line_display_name FROM ( SELECT e.equip_id, e.equip_code, e.equip_name, e.equip_status, e.equip_loc,
l.line_id, l.line_code, l.line_name, l.line_status,
e.equip_code || ' / ' || e.equip_name AS equip_display_name, l.line_code || ' / ' || l.line_name AS line_display_name
FROM equipment e
LEFT JOIN line l ON l.line_id = e.line_id
WHERE NVL(e.use_yn, 'Y') = 'Y' AND ( UPPER(e.equip_code) LIKE '%' || UPPER(#{keyword}) || '%' OR UPPER(e.equip_name) LIKE '%' || UPPER(#{keyword}) || '%' OR UPPER(l.line_code) LIKE '%' || UPPER(#{keyword}) || '%' OR UPPER(l.line_name) LIKE '%' || UPPER(#{keyword}) || '%' )
ORDER BY CASE WHEN UPPER(e.equip_code) = UPPER(#{keyword}) THEN 1 WHEN UPPER(e.equip_name) = UPPER(#{keyword}) THEN 2 WHEN UPPER(e.equip_code) LIKE UPPER(#{keyword}) || '%' THEN 3 WHEN UPPER(e.equip_name) LIKE UPPER(#{keyword}) || '%' THEN 4 ELSE 5 END, e.equip_code ) WHERE ROWNUM <= 10

SELECT e.equip_id, e.equip_code, e.equip_name, e.equip_status, e.equip_loc,
l.line_id, l.line_code, l.line_name, l.line_status,
e.equip_code || ' / ' || e.equip_name AS equip_display_name, l.line_code || ' / ' || l.line_name AS line_display_name
FROM equipment e
LEFT JOIN line l ON l.line_id = e.line_id
WHERE NVL(e.use_yn, 'Y') = 'Y'
ORDER BY l.line_code, e.equip_code
